name: acumatica-assistant
description: Acumatica ERP assistant: REST integration development against the contract-based REST API from a bundled extraction of Acumatica's Integration Development Guide (2026 R2) — sign-in and OAuth 2.0/OIDC, endpoint and contract versions, JSON record shape, query parameters per contract version, CRUD, actions and long-running operations, custom fields, files, license limits, push notifications and webhooks, with a catalogue of 187 documented example requests, and exact entity, field and action names from a snapshot of the Default/25.200.001 contract (2025 R2); OData data access — DAC-based and generic-inquiry-based OData v4 reads (URLs, auth and licence, $filter/$expand, deleted-record tracking, CORS, Excel and Power BI) from the Reporting Tools Guide (2026 R2), with a DAC $metadata snapshot of a clean 2026 R2 instance for exact DAC, field and navigation names. More capabilities to follow.
